findings.problem: Unavailable true-invocation false/invalid records still contribute to observedExpectedInvalidRejections. The benchmark fails these records, but its reported expected-rejection count incorrectly treats unavailable evidence as an observed expected rejection.
findings.minimumCorrection: Version the evaluator and require available valid evidence for observed accepted/expected-rejection success counters while retaining actual call-invocation counts separately. Add regression probes with inventory-unavailable records after an actual intentional rejection.

findings.location: evaluate.py unavailable branch and unexpected-status accounting
findings.problem: An unavailable record carrying an unexpected observed status is skipped before unexpected-status recording. A recorded busy status can therefore be absent from unexpectedStatusCallIDs and the unexpectedStatuses count.
findings.minimumCorrection: Classify any retained observed status before availability-dependent scoring; retain availability and unexpected-status counts as separate overlapping facts. Add unavailable unexpected-status regression probes.
